name: Havise Pike
title: Household servant
core_character_description: You worked as a household servant and are now held from Bell-and-Sluice streets, still tied to a shared bell-and-sluice work-and-lodging group. Stone House rations and food carried in by kin are your present support. You bargain cheerfully and remember exact sums. Today you need to have a sore heel looked at. A loop of blue cord holds your hair back.
goal: Have a sore heel looked at
